d:
Need your packages handled? Are you the type to say "send your cutest delivery boy,"? Do you like FLYGON maybe a little too much? Well, you can never like Flygon too much, but you also don't need to look any further! This NSFW art pack celebrates FLYGON and contains 88 images and MULTIPLE ANIMATIONS of flygon, by 61 artists for you to enjoy, completely for FREE!

Unlike our previous projects, (Starbugs and Lugia After Dark; check them out as well!) FLYGONSEXPRESS has a loose overarching story between the pieces.

Our titular flygon, Jay, has started his own courier business and what's a business without advertising? Jay recruited his Hisuian Typhlosion best friend to design and print out countless flyers to get word out about the Flygon's services. Little did the dragon type realize, Typhlosion, as a little joke, twisted the words of the advertisements into seeming like Jay's main business involved a different sort of package handling. Jay is the type to go-with-the-flow, so whatever happens at his stops he accepts as just part of the job as a delivery boy. You all probably know what happens next.

The pack is organized into 2 sections: story and non-story. The former ties into the aforementioned story while the latter is just like our previous packs-- miscellaneous flygon art, involving off-model Jay or not involving Jay at all.

As a little bonus, we're making our Jay the Flygon OC free for anyone to draw or commission artwork of. In fact, almost any future artwork of Jay drawn by anyone will be considered canon to his story and business.
